hey guys i got a messeage! ------------------------------------------------------ Hey everyone, So, I suppose this is a bit of a goodbye… but it’s not a forever kind of thing. I've been part of 50xCreative for quite a while now, and honestly, it’s been such a blast. I’ve had the chance to create things like the City of Faith, participate in the Duck War and N.U.K.E., and just hang out with all of you. Sure, it’s been a bit chaotic at times, but that’s what made it so memorable. I’ve met some truly awesome people here, and even those random moments and silly arguments are the kind of stuff I’m likely to look back on fondly. It wasn’t merely a Minecraft server; it really felt like a genuine community. I want to clarify that I’m not leaving due to any negative reasons. I just need to take a step back and focus on some other things for a while. So yeah, I’ll be out for a bit, but definitely not for good. I don’t want to get too sentimental here, but seriously, make sure to enjoy what you have while it lasts. Whether it’s this server or life in general, don’t take it for granted. Anyway, thanks for all the great memories so far. I’ll catch up with you all again sometime. Take care, everyone! Your femboy duck -Life (edited)

I first joined the 50xCreative Minecraft server on 13th of January 2023 through Minehut, while I was randomly browsing servers. Upon my first join, I saw players spreading a purple and black block corruption. That was my first impression of 50x. I never thought I would play much on this server, much less that I would join the staff team, because I had experience with short-lived Minecraft servers. But as time went on, I kept coming back. I eventually joined the staff team in March of 2023. Back then players like Diffenyy and Hercules were still active. As time went on old staffs retire or get banned, and new waves of staff replace the old ones. But I never left. Even though I was and still am not a good builder, I stuck around because of the appeal of the server. Every notebot song played, every Tag game won, every underground mall, every player interaction, every roleplay, every event, every ban and every troll was a part of my core memory on the server. This is corny ik but it was really that awesome. In the end however, what made the server so special was the players. So shout out to these people I met through 50x. Even though some of them might be controversial to you I still had a great time with them: Djesse (person who stuck around 50x longer than I did, inspirational builder) Star Kundaliel (coding wiz) CriticalG_ (chill staff) 3_tap (also another goated builder) Ckream (met you during the 2023 mobvote LOL remember) Agent (my favorite enderman) TheBear (thanks for helping with my PC) Daphil (best duck) Horizon (thanks for helping me build that one elevator) Tubbo Tangy ( insanely detailed builder) Piggydoom (funniest staff) Liferobbers (thanks for letting me build on the city of faith, legit the coolest project ever on 50x) TheLastArchivist (cool nbts dude) Combatfly (weirdest 50x player) Fragola (your bot was like the pandora's box) potator123 (nuke corp is insane) E_00000001 (talented redstoner) (edited)
